tess: Heads-up: for the launch post + webinar we need a tiny, verifiable bench pack to back two claims (short demo latency and long-context tradeoffs). Can runtime do a focused smoke run?
ron: Yep. What counts as 'tiny'?
tess: Minimal: per-request CSV, manifest with exact model checksum, qps/warmup params, and one PNG with p50/p95/p99 bars for the deck. Also include 8 token-level traces (sampled).
marta: Which model/hw/quant?
tess: model-v5 (marketing tag), h100-small pool, int8 + fp16. Short demo: 256 tokens @50qps. Long slide: 2048 tokens streaming @10qps. Warmup: 3 windows. Use seed mkting-24.
dev-runner: Got it. We'll produce artifact.tar.gz containing manifest.txt, per_request.csv, token_traces.csv (8 rows), README.md, and pxx_chart.png.
ron: Any wording constraints? Marketing will say "single-run smoke; expect variance" — include that in README.
tess: Yes add: "single-run smoke artifacts; allow ±10% on p95 due to scheduler/cache variance."
dev-runner: Job queued: 99730 on h100-small. ETA smoke 45m. runtime-bot: queued 99730.
tess: Thanks — can you post GCS link when done? Need it by EOD today.
dev-runner: upload complete: gs://redwood-marketing/launch/1799994322/smoke_pack.tar.gz (2.2MB). runtime-bot: job 99730 finished successfully.
tess: Downloading now, will verify and update slides. If we need a rerun we'll request here.
ron: If they ask for a quick rerun at different qps we can do fast-turnaround on one variant. :ok_hand:
